title: Deep link + in-app control for Live Camera Recording tab

requirements.summary: Support a query param deep link that opens the Live page with the Camera Recording tab selected on first render.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Live page with a query parameter (e.g. /live?mode=camera) opens the Live page with the 'Camera Recording' tab selected.
Navigating to /live with no query parameter continues to default to the existing 'Simulated Live Feed' tab.
Switching tabs in the UI keeps working as it does now and does not break the simulated polling pause/refetch behavior.
All user-facing text related to this behavior is in English.

file_operations.description: Initialize the Live page tab state from a URL query parameter (mode=camera) on first render while preserving the existing default ('simulated') when the parameter is absent/invalid; ensure tab switching continues to drive captureMode and that simulated polling remains paused whenever captureMode is 'camera'. This wiring must keep all user-facing text in English. Note: the camera experience relies on the existing CameraCaptureRecorderCard which uses the selected 'camera' component's useCamera hook—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add (or extend) a small, non-breaking utility helper to read a specific query parameter value in a way compatible with the app’s routing patterns (regular search and hash search), so LivePage can reliably interpret mode=camera without duplicating parsing logic.

requirements.summary: Add an in-page control on Live that switches directly into Camera Recording mode without manual tab selection and without starting the camera.
acceptanceCriteria: Live page includes a clearly labeled control (English text) that switches the Live page into 'Camera Recording' mode when clicked.
The control does not start the camera automatically; it only switches to the camera tab so the user can click 'Enable Camera'.
The existing bottom tab navigation and desktop navigation remain unchanged and continue to route to /live.

file_operations.description: Add a clearly labeled in-page UI control (e.g., a Button labeled "Open live camera") that sets captureMode to 'camera' when clicked, without invoking any camera-start logic; ensure it does not alter existing navigation components (PrimaryNav/BottomTabNav) and keeps all user-facing text in English. Note: the camera tab uses CameraCaptureRecorderCard which relies on the selected 'camera' component—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
